# dotnet-1.27.0

## What Changed

[1.27.0] 2026 10 30 Added skills: Add a .NET consumer skill for building with Agent Framework ( 9651 by @westey m). .NET, CI: Add a script to bump the .NET release version ( 9894 by @baywet). Changed .NET, AgentServer: [BREAKING] Update AgentServer dependencies ( 9721 by @rogerbarreto). Migration: In Foundry hosted applications, replace builder.Services.AddFoundryResponses(...) with builder.AddFoundryResponses(...) so response and task storage use the same configuration bound identity and endpoint. The IServiceCollection overload remains supported for local or non hosted use. If you pin SDK dependencies directly, align Azure.AI.Projects and Azure.AI.Extensions.OpenAI to 3.0.0 beta.5 , and Azure.AI.AgentServer.Core , Azure.AI.AgentServer.Invocations , and Azure.AI.AgentServer.Responses to 1.0.0 beta.30 , 1.0.0 beta.7 , and 1.0.0 beta.9 , respectively. Align Azure.Core to 1.63.0 , System.ClientModel to 1.16.0 , and Microsoft.Identity.Client.Extensions.Msal to 4.90.0 . For code using the affected SDK APIs directly, replace string storage ETags with Azure.ETag ( ETag ifMatch = default in state store overrides), stream.InternalMetadata with stream.PersistedMetadata , stream.Checkpoin...
